summary: Replay the already Windows-verified Issue #70 interpreter-resolution fix on top of the new dual-OS CI main so both Windows PATHEXT behavior and POSIX executable-bit semantics become merge-gated without reverting Issue #72 infrastructure.
steps: PR #94 had passed the former Windows-only CI, but became intentionally non-mergeable after Issue #72 changed main's test/CI baseline. Created a fresh Issue #70 branch from main commit 2e406e9 instead of force-overwriting the new main.
Replayed only the three material changes: spawnable ordinary-file validation, PATHEXT-aware Windows command resolution, and focused Windows/POSIX tests wired into the full suite.
Preserved the new Issue #72 workflow and POSIX process regression unchanged.

evidence.note: The exact production logic and Windows-focused full suite passed before the rebase replay.
This successor branch must pass the new Windows+Ubuntu gate before merge.

limitations: The successor dual-OS CI has not run yet.
Shell aliases remain intentionally unsupported because the runtime directly spawns a command rather than using an interactive shell.
